scenario_description:
Objective: Have tomorrow’s county well-water courier pickup include the bacteria sample rather than only mineral bottles.
Emerging Need: The required pre-dosed bacteria bottle is assumed available at first, then the mudroom sleeve proves empty while replacement set-asides are still possible.
Decision Context: Stored sampling notes identify the non-substitutable bottle and limit the response to obtaining a replacement kit; live records establish pickup timing, the missing item, and the set-aside route.
Consequence: Once the bottle desk closes, the courier can still collect other samples, but the bacteria test lacks its prerequisite and must wait for another cycle.

parameter.title: County well-water sample courier pickup
parameter.description: Leave sealed well-water sample kit on the mudroom shelf by 08:30 for the county courier route.

parameter.subject: Tomorrow's rural well sample pickup
parameter.body: Your rural well sample pickup is on tomorrow's courier route. Missing or unsealed lab bottles cannot ride with the courier. Same-day replacement bottle set-asides are accepted only until 15:00 today; after that, replacements are walk-up only after tomorrow's route leaves.

parameter.content: I put the firewood receipt on the mudroom shelf and checked the water-sample kit like you asked last week. The clear mineral bottle is sealed, but the small blue-capped bacteria bottle sleeve is empty.

parameter.name: Washington County Water Lab Desk
parameter.notes: Handles same-day replacement bottle set-asides for rural courier customers; requests before 15:00 may be held on the north lobby shelf.

parameter.subject: Bottle desk closed for tomorrow courier kits
parameter.body: The replacement-bottle desk is closed for tomorrow's courier kits. The courier can still collect any sealed bottles already on site, but missing bacteria bottles must be picked up in person after the route has left and will go on a later sample cycle.
